name: Lily
source:
Role: Assistant Prosthetist
Disability: none
bio: Lily is Max's capable and compassionate assistant. She has a knack for making patients feel at ease and is deeply dedicated to her work. Outside the rehabilitation center, Lily enjoys painting and hiking. Her friendly nature and professional demeanor make her an indispensable part of the team.
